_highlightGoals_note: Sales Scoreboard green-highlight thresholds (change in one spot). A rep's Rev/Sit or Close Rate turns green when it is >= the threshold (checked independently).
_targetSlots_note: Total rep slots on the scoreboard. Reps fill top-down; any remaining slots show as 'WE'RE HIRING / OPEN SEAT'. openSeats = max(0, targetSlots - reps). 7 slots with 5 reps = 2 open seats.
_reps_note: Display names only. WHO is on the sales team comes from rr-metrics settings.json (sales_team). Add a rep there; add a row here only to set a nicer display name/role. fullName must match the AccuLynx name exactly or the row is ignored. Adding or removing a rep: follow CLAUDE.md in rapidhsg/rr-metrics-data.
_setter_note: Show every 'Appointment Set By' value EXCEPT these junk/inactive buckets (case-insensitive; blanks always excluded). New CSRs auto-appear. Janet excluded — left the company 2026-07-07.
